notes.bbb_note: The label does not state that minocycline crosses the blood-brain barrier; however, it does describe central nervous system side effects (lightheadedness, dizziness, vertigo) and intracranial hypertension associated with its use, indicating CNS activity.
notes.safety_note: The label contains multiple warnings but no traditional boxed warning; the headline warnings include tooth/skeletal development effects in children, dermatologic reactions, intracranial hypertension (pseudotumor cerebri), and CNS side effects with patients cautioned against driving or operating hazardous machinery.
